meta.name: openspec-propose
meta.description: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提出新变更，自动生成设计与任务清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速把想法整理成完整的开发方案
copy.tagline_en: Generate a complete change proposal with design and specs in one go.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn a rough idea into a structured implementation plan quickly.

howto.what: 安装后，当你描述想构建的功能或修复时，Claude会用openspec CLI创建变更目录，依次生成proposal.md、design.md、tasks.md等工件，直到全部就绪，并给出实现提示。
howto.when: 当你想快速描述要构建的内容，并希望一次性得到包含设计、规格和任务的完整提案时触发。如果描述不明确，会先询问。

say.text: 帮我提议新增用户登录功能，生成完整提案
say.note: Claude会创建变更目录并生成设计、规格和任务文档。

say.text: 我要添加购物车功能，请一次生成所有工件
say.note: 若名称不清会先询问，再按步骤生成。

say.text: 修复登录超时问题，创建一个变更提案
say.note: 会搭建变更结构并准备实现任务。

howto.what_en: After install, when you describe a feature or fix, Claude uses the openspec CLI to create a change dir and generate proposal.md, design.md, tasks.md in order until all are ready, then prompts implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to quickly describe what to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks. If unclear, it asks first.

say_en.text: Propose adding user login and generate a full proposal.
say_en.note: Claude creates change dir; writes design, spec, tasks.

say_en.text: I want to add a cart feature; create all artifacts in one step.
say_en.note: It will ask for a name if needed, then generate files.

say_en.text: Fix the login timeout and create a change proposal.
say_en.note: It will scaffold the change and prepare tasks.
